name: Stateless JWT installation token
description: The stateless installation token: a ghs_-prefixed JWT, written ghs_APPID_JWT, about 520 characters long (varying with its contents) and containing two dots, signed with a GitHub-internal issuer and not for clients to parse or validate. It replaces the opaque form for newly minted tokens as the staged rollout reaches an installation; the APPID segment grammar is not documented, and a ghs_ value without it also matches the provider-recommended regex.

history.note: GitHub announced on 2026-04-24 a staged rollout starting 2026-04-27, and on 2026-05-15 added a temporary per-request header (enabled) to request this form on demand. A statement on rollout completion was not found on the pages read; it is recorded as an open question in the contract, not as a fact.

sources.supports: Staged rollout starting 2026-04-27; token format changes to ghs_APPID_JWT.
Header value enabled returns a stateless (JWT-format) token regardless of rollout position; a stateless token is a ghs_-prefixed JWT with two dots.
